meta.name: plan-writing
meta.description: Structured task planning with clear breakdowns, dependencies, and verification criteria. Use when implementing features, refactoring, or any multi-step work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务拆成清晰计划并明确验收标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手前想把复杂工作理清步骤与依赖。
copy.tagline_en: Turn multi-step work into a clear plan with dependencies and checkpoints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan before starting a complex task.

howto.what: Claude 会把多步骤工作拆成 2–5 分钟的小任务,每个任务写明具体动作和验证方式,并按依赖排序;计划存为项目根目录下的 {任务名}.md 文件,结构含 Goal、Tasks、Done When,任务数不超过 10 个。
howto.when: 当任务涉及实现功能、重构或任何多步骤工作时触发;也适用于新建项目、修复复杂 bug 等场景。

say.text: 帮我规划登录功能,拆成小任务,每个都写清验证方法。
把这次重构拆成不超过10个可验证的任务,计划存到项目根目录。
say.note: 计划会以 md 文件保存。

say.text: 新建项目前先做份开发计划,列明技术栈和依赖顺序。
say.note: 计划会包含具体命令和验证步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks multi-step work into small 2–5 minute tasks with concrete actions and verification, ordered by dependencies. Plan saved as {task-slug}.md in project root, with Goal/Tasks/Done When, max 10 tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when implementing features, refactoring, or any multi-step work; also for new projects and complex bug fixes.

say_en.text: Plan the login feature, break it into small tasks, and give verification steps for each.
say_en.note: Generates a plan with Goal, Tasks, Done When.

say_en.text: Break this refactor into at most 10 verifiable tasks and save the plan in the project root.
say_en.note: Plan is saved as a markdown file.

say_en.text: Before starting a new project, make a plan with the tech stack and dependency order.
say_en.note: Plan includes concrete commands and verification steps.
